name: unown-local-ml
description: OPTIONAL local ONNX embedding lane for the Unown self-learning engine (H15). NOT a bun/npm workspace member on purpose: this directory owns its own node_modules so the repo and the engine stay native-addon-free. Install on demand: npm install in this directory (downloads onnxruntime-node prebuilds ~287MB unpacked). When absent, the engine's localml lanes degrade to their symbolic-only verified shapes and the dream pipeline is unchanged.
